direction: Inspired by Yan Long action legends with a fiery dragon warrior, side-scrolling combat, flame powers, and boss-focused chapter progression.
selected_concept: Side-scrolling action stage game where a fire dragon warrior clears enemy waves, builds heat energy, transforms into a half-dragon burst state, and defeats chapter bosses.
visual_differentiation_axes: molten forge action HUD instead of tactical or cute layouts
heat-focused upper-left meter cluster with corner combat controls
black steel and ember palette rather than neon or pastel balance
dragon-warrior head icon instead of map, city, or bunker motifs
boss warning overlays and forge-metal screen motifs
forbidden_visual_reuse: top pill chain plus bottom strategy strip
generic sword crest icon without dragon identity

ui_identity.layout_archetype: top combat ribbon with lower-corner controls and centered boss overlays
ui_identity.hud_composition: upper-left health and heat upper-right score and timer upper-center boss strip lower-left stick lower-right action cluster
ui_identity.navigation_model: menu to chapter map to stage battle with separate upgrades and boss-intel screens
ui_identity.palette_signature: black steel ember orange molten gold deep crimson and cyan-white spark highlights
ui_identity.material_language: forged metal, dragon-scale accents, ember glass, and glowing heat channels
ui_identity.typography_style: bold arcade combat lettering with sharp condensed numerals

reserved_edges: lower-left corner for movement stick dead space
lower-right corner for action cluster dead space
playfield_safety.frame_overlay_policy: forge-metal framing and decorative dragon ornaments must remain outside the live combat lane and never cover active threats or dodge routes

unique_screen_motifs: upgrade screen as dragon shrine forge altar
result card with cracked molten seal
forbidden_ui_elements: full-screen decorative frame over combat space

icon_identity.subject: roaring half-dragon warrior head
icon_identity.silhouette: forward-leaning dragon-warrior face with one blazing horn crest and a wide flame arc
icon_identity.composition: close-up dragon-warrior head fills the icon with a diagonal flame arc and dark forged backing plate
icon_identity.palette: hot orange crimson black steel gold ember accents
icon_identity.background: dark forge glow with molten sparks rather than map or crest motifs
icon_identity.game_specific_motif: half-dragon overdrive identity and flame burst jawline
